sources.title: MPNet — transformers 4.7.0 documentation - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is used to instantiate a MPNet model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the MPNet mpnet-base architecture. Configuration objects inherit from PretrainedConfig and can be used to control the model outputs.
